headline: A Tech Policy Press podcast examined how AI and other technology trends are reshaping the pace of war, as ChinaTalk's Q3 roundup touched on AI, China and defense, and Silicon Valley fell in line with Trump's 'super intelligence' rebrand.

points.text: A Tech Policy Press podcast with Steve Feldstein examined how technology, including AI, is changing the pace and character of war, alongside other trends reshaping conflict.
A ChinaTalk roundup of takeaways from the third quarter touched on AI, China, defense, national security and supply chains.
Silicon Valley companies are increasingly falling in line with Trump's push to rebrand artificial intelligence as 'super intelligence,' even as the broader public sticks with 'AI.'
